custom_logic_notes: EA places Buy Stop and Sell Stop pending orders at a specified distance from current price when server time is within a configurable time window (StartTime to EndTime). Orders are placed once and monitored; if not triggered by EndTime, pending orders are deleted. Distance from current price for pending order placement is configurable. SL and TP are set relative to the pending order price (not current price). The EA checks for existing pending orders before placing new ones to avoid duplication.
